bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$p" || exit 71
printf 'STK04_TABLES\n'
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT to_regclass(\x27public.posting_topics\x27),to_regclass(\x27public.posting_sticker_entry_pins\x27)"' || true
printf 'STK04_TOPIC_READBACK\n'
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT topic_id,board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,enabled,verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id=-1002373696859 AND (purpose=\x27sticker\x27 OR title ILIKE \x27%ステッカー%\x27) ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 10"' || echo STK04_TOPIC_QUERY_FAILED
printf 'STK04_PIN_RECEIPTS\n'
docker exec "$p" sh -c 'psql -At -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -c "SELECT topic_id,status,telegram_message_id,creator_bot_username FROM posting_sticker_entry_pins ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 10"' || echo STK04_PIN_TABLE_UNAVAILABLE
printf 'STK04_HOST_HTTPS\n'
curl -LsS -o /dev/null --connect-timeout 6 --max-time 10 -w 'STK04_HOST_HTTPS_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' https://api.telegram.org/ || echo STK04_HOST_HTTPS_UNAVAILABLE
